turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Recording lectures sounds good but doubles your time, so I'd avoid it except for hard topics. Handwritten notes plus a quick summary that evening is a strong combination for most people.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Things like word guessing games, drawing games, or making your own quiz. There are also print and play games you print at home for free.
